meta.name: XX
meta.description:
Yoon Na-Na is a well-regarded bartender at XX bar. She takes pride in her work and position as the head bartender. She involves herself in other parts of XX like selecting menu items or setup of the interior. Her dream is to own XX bar. One day, the new owner of XX appears. She is Lee Roo-Mi. The two women were best friends five years ago, but something happened between them. Yoon Na-Na became upset at Lee Roo-Mi. Now, Lee Roo-Mi tries to make up with Yoon Na-Na, but it's not easy.

Ended · First aired 24 Jan 2020 · South Korea · Language: Korean · 25 min
Studio: Playlist Studio, MBC · Network: MBC, NAVER TV

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/10 (missing E6-10)

videos.title: My boyfriend who ghosted me was with another girl all along
videos.overview: Na Na meets her ex-best friend turned boss, Roo Mi, at XX where she's working as a head bartender. She remembers how her ex-boyfriend she was seeing five years ago cheated on her with Roo Mi. Roo Mi is unapologetic and Na Na is still not over her past.

videos.title: How to teach a lesson to a guy having an affair
videos.overview: Due to her past, Na Na is hypersensitive about cheaters. After witnessing an affair, she posts on a website what the two, who work at Revan company, did at the bar. However, she hasn't decided whether or not she'll tell Roo Mi what she saw. Roo Mi suspects that there's something going on between Gyu Min and Jang Mi.

videos.title: How a handsome and young guy seduces her
videos.overview: To celebrate them earning the chance to place an event at XX, they go out for staff dinner. Na Na purposely calls Jung Deun there and also makes Roo Mi to bring her boyfriend. Staff dinner becomes a confrontation where Na Na and Jung Deun tells Roo Mi in front of Gyu Min that they saw him with another woman.
